title: Apply to be a registered land or mining surveyor
summary: Find out the requirements and steps to apply for registration as a land or mining surveyor in NSW.

### Working in NSW with an interstate or New Zealand registration

If you're a registered land surveyor from another Australian state you're able to work in NSW under the Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) scheme. If you intend to work in NSW under AMR you must notify the regulator, the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information NSW.

If you're a registered mining surveyor from another Australian state you'll need to apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information NSW for mutual recognition.

If you're a registered surveyor (land or mining) from New Zealand you'll need to apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information NSW for mutual recognition.

what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or your OneGov account.
Certified copies of the following documents (in English and PDF format, maximum file size 4MB):
A passport quality photo in JPG format.
A credit or debit card for the registration fee.
Mutual recognition applicants also need additional documentation.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or log in using your OneGov credentials.
Follow the prompts to apply to be a registered surveyor.

faqs.q: How can I work in NSW if I am a registered surveyor from another Australian state?
faqs.a: If you are a registered land surveyor from another Australian state, you can work in NSW under the Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) scheme. If you are a registered mining surveyor, you must apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information NSW for mutual recognition.

faqs.q: What do I need if I am a registered surveyor from New Zealand?
faqs.a: You will need to apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information NSW for mutual recognition.

faqs.q: What are the general requirements to apply for registration?
faqs.a: You must be a candidate surveyor in NSW holding a Certificate of Competency, or registered in another Australian state/territory or New Zealand.
